deviations: cjoint is not installed: cjoint::read.qualtrics() was re-implemented (Qualtrics new-format CSV, F-task-attr / F-task-profile-attr columns, selected = chosen profile, NA choices dropped, respondent-major order) and cjoint::amce() was replaced by OLS via fixest::feols with SEs clustered by respondent (cjoint's small-sample SE adjustment may differ slightly; SEs are not claimed).

German model includes the Language x Origin interaction, which is what cjoint::amce adds for the restriction declared in conjoint_design_german2.dat; the Reason AMCE is the Reason coefficient from that regression. The US design's restriction names 'Country of Origin', which is not a design attribute, and the US data show no restriction, so the US model is additive. Alternatives are printed as diagnostics and differ by under 0.001.
notes: Two exploratory runs (column layout, reshape, counts; no RESULT lines), then one estimating run, which is final. Follows Migration_Analysis_Final.R: US drops 'Unemployer' rows (none present) and the first 4 profile rows; baselines Economic opportunity / Wirtschaftliche Perspektive. All 12 claims reproduced at the reported precision: US AMCEs 0.035/0.037/0.040/0.076, German 0.080/0.086/0.060/0.162, 1086/1074 respondents, 18966/18862 profiles. No claim comparison changed the script, so no claim attempts are recorded.
